newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Sept 30.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on September 30:
WASHINGTON - President Clinton invited Israeli and Arab leaders to a White House meeting this week aimed at defusing the worst outbreak of street fighting in years.
BET EL, WEST BANK - Israel deployed tanks and troops and imposed a strict ban on Arab travel between cities and towns.
WASHINGTON - Advocacy groups across the country are poised to go to court as early as next week to challenge the legal underpinnings of the new welfare law that takes full effect on Tuesday.
WASHINGTON - There have been success stories in states' efforts to reform welfare programmes, but the impact of the new federal welfare reform law is still unclear.

WASHINGTON - A self-styled campaign watchdog group, which recently released a study detailing millions of dollars of campaign contributions by trial lawyers, was created by a public relations firm hired by Philip Morris Co and secretly conducted the study for the tobacco giant.
DULUTH, MINNESOTA - Hundreds of deformed frogs are turning up all over Minnesota.

WASHINGTON - With hindsight, it has now become clear that supporters of the North American Free Trade Agreement oversold its benefits during the 1992 election campaign, while critics exaggerated its drawbacks.
